(1) A mechanical retention measure fixed in advance: the share of the originating turn's content words and of its quoted phrases recovered in each version, against a shuffled-turn baseline. (3) The owner, on a random subsample. A claim of retention or of drift is counted only where all three agree; disagreement is reported as a finding about the probes.
